title: Converse weighted transfer: a weighted approximate tangent plane of M at y is the approximate tangent plane of the piece C ⊆ M (Simon Ch. 3, Remark 1.8(1): T_y M as in Def. 1.7 ⇒ T_y C as in Def. 1.4)
statement: Let Q, n ∈ ℕ and μ := Hⁿ = μHE[n] on ℝ^Q. Let M, C ⊆ ℝ^Q be μ-null-measurable with C ⊆ M, let θ : ℝ^Q → ℝ satisfy θ ≥ 0 on M, let y ∈ ℝ^Q with θ(y) > 0, and let T be a linear subspace of ℝ^Q which is the approximate tangent space of M at y with respect to θ (HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ y T, Simon Ch. 3, Def. 1.7). Assume that some r > 0 has μ(C ∩ B̄_r(y)) < ∞ and θ μ-integrable on M ∩ B̄_r(y); that θ|C is continuous at y (ContinuousWithinAt θ C y); and that θHⁿ⌞(M ∖ C) has n-density 0 at y, i.e. (∫⁻_{(M∖C) ∩ B̄_ρ(y)} ofReal(θ) dμ) / ofReal(ρⁿ) → 0 as ρ → 0+. Then T is the approximate tangent space of C at y (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n C y T, Def. 1.4).
lean_statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (M C : Set (Eucl Q)) (θ : Eucl Q → ℝ) (y : Eucl Q) (T : Submodule ℝ (Eucl Q)), NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) → NullMeasurableSet C (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) → C ⊆ M → (∀ x ∈ M, 0 ≤ θ x) → 0 < θ y → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ y T → (∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) (C ∩ closedBall y r) < ∞ ∧ IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ closedBall y r) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q))) → ContinuousWithinAt θ C y → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => (∫⁻ x in (M \ C) ∩ closedBall y ρ, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q))) / ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n C y T
